QuestInfo.name: [Elodin] Anne's Nightmares
QuestInfo.0: #b#p1012110##k is still as white as a sheet, but she looks ready to talk. Ask her what happened.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p1012110##k is still as white as a sheet, but she looks ready to talk. Ask her what happened.
QuestInfo.2: #b#p1012110##k saw something disturbing in the South Forest of Ellinia.

0.msg: I've had nightmares ever since that day.

1.msg: I could hear bone-chilling screams and crying deep within the forest.

2.msg: Do you think the veiled woman I saw in the forest is a witch of the woods?

3.msg: With every passing day, I'm more scared she's gonna pop out of my closet one night and the last thing I see will be her terrifying black veil...

4.msg: This must be why nobody goes to the South Forest...

5.msg: If the adults find out I've been there, I'll be in trouble for sure! And that's if the witch doesn't get me first!

6.msg: Please find the witch in the deepest part of the South Forest in Ellinia and beg her not to hurt me... discreetly!

0.msg: Maybe if you find her, the nightmares will stop too.
What? You can't just leave me here to fend for myself!
